I work as a post doc at Wageningen University with Pieter Zuidema, and I'm
excited to be at Cornell for three months, visiting the Xu lab. I'm a tropical
ecologist, interested in tree growth and physiology. Specifically, I work on how
tropical canopy trees respond to fluctuations in weather, climate change and
rising CO~2~. I study this using tree rings, isotopes and modeling. I am
currently working on developing a new module for ED2 in which we try to capture
the mechanism of wood formation. I am from the Netherlands and in my free time I
enjoy drawing, painting, cycling, kayaking, camping and last but not least,
cuddling my cat!
